description: Multiple windows for Claude Desktop with different APIs at the same time: keep your official Claude subscription in one window and run other windows on custom / third-party APIs (cc-switch). Windows. 多开 Claude Desktop,多个窗口同时使用不同 API(官方订阅 + 第三方 API 同时工作)。
